segments.name: Sustainable infrastructure
segments.description: Invests in sustainable infrastructure assets advancing the energy transition for clean energy developers, utilities, and energy service companies.
segments.evidence: We manage our business as a single portfolio which we originate from a single pipeline, and accordingly we report all of our activities as one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: The company earns interest income, equity method investment income, gains on asset sales through securitizations, management fees from co-investment vehicles and securitized assets, and residual income from retained securitized assets.
revenueModel.evidence: The returns we generate on our investments are generally derived from five primary sources: (1) interest income, (2) income from equity method investments, (3) gains on the sale of assets through securitizations, (4) fee revenue from co-investment vehicles and securitized assets that we manage, and (5) residual income generated by the portion of securitized assets that we have retained.

changes.text: In 2024 the company revoked its REIT status and became taxed as a C Corporation.
changes.evidence: In December 2023, our Board approved our revocation of our REIT status effective January 1, 2024, and we are taxed as a C Corporation beginning with tax year 2024.
